name: prompt-pal-staff
title: Prompt Pal - Staff
summary: A prompt library and coaching partner for everyday staff work — email, meeting notes, documents, and project planning.
description: Prompt Pal for Staff is an interactive chat tool that helps university staff write better AI prompts for everyday work. Ask for ready-made prompts for common tasks — cleaning up an email, drafting a professional message, summarizing meeting notes or a report, extracting action items, building a project checklist or timeline, organizing spreadsheet data, outlining a presentation — or paste your own draft and get coached on improving it. Every request returns a basic version, an enhanced version built with the PROMPT framework (Persona, Requirements, Organization, Medium, Purpose, Tone), and a CLEAR check (Concise, Logical, Explicit, Adaptive, Reflective). It only writes and refines prompts — you copy the result into Claude, ChatGPT, or another AI tool to actually run it.
examples: I need a prompt for summarizing these meeting notes into key takeaways and action items.
I need a prompt for rewriting this email so it sounds more professional.
Here is a draft prompt I wrote — can you coach me on improving it?
author: Office of Instructional Innovation, McCombs School of Business
